title: Page 7
content_zh:
“那人是谁？”寒招财已等不及想知道答案。

“赖川供出那人是娄梓纲。”娄梓纲身为娄家唯一嫡子，他委实想不出他为何要买通外人，来杀害自己的妹妹。

“竟然是他？他为何要这么做？”听闻是他，寒招财有些意外。

“赖川也不知原由，以前娄梓纲在娄家待你如何？”路挽风试着想找出娄梓纲找人杀害她的原因。

“虽然没怎么亲近，但我在娄家那几个月里，他也没难为过我。”寒招财思索，“你还记得我上回同你提讨，我看到娄竹心的那两段残缺的记忆吗，会不会是娄竹心发觉他什么把柄，所以他才一再找人想除掉她？”

“看来应是如此，否则他没道理这么做。”只不知那把柄究竟是什么，竟让娄梓纲不顾兄妹之情，狠心让人害死她。

“既然那赖川已供出娄梓纲，那知府大人可会派将他抓起来治罪？”寒招财关切的追问这事。

“杨捕头已去向严大人禀告这事，严大人应当会命人去拘捕娄梓纲。”

“那会判死罪吗？”这人如此可恶，不顾手足之情，该得到他应得的惩罚。

路挽风摇首，“暂时还不会，按理会先审问他。”

此时公堂上，知府严大人在接到杨捕头的禀告后，便传令提审娄梓纲。

被带进公堂，娄梓纲有些不满的质疑，“严大人，你命人传唤草民前来，不知是何故？”

“有人告发你涉及一桩命案。”

“何人竟胡乱污蔑？我堂堂娄家少爷，岂会涉及什么命案，大人可不要听信旁人的诬告。”娄梓纲怒斥。

严大人拍下惊堂木，警告他，“不得咆哮公堂，本府办案，自会查明清楚，秉公处理。”

娄梓纲当即收敛怒色，“大人恕罪，草民适才因为被人诬告，故而一时义愤。”

“有人指控你买凶杀妹，给了杀手一千两银子，让他替你去杀害娄四姑娘，可有此事？”

“绝无此事，这人分明胡说八道！这城里谁人不知，舍妹乃是先前去庄子里避暑时，不幸水而死，与我何干？”娄梓纲接着不忿的质问，“敢问大人，这诬指我之人究竟是何人？”

“指证你之人名叫赖川，你可识得他？”

娄梓纲心中一骇，但脸上不动声色的表示，“原来是他啊，他是苏云城里的一个地痞，他这分明是挟怨报复，才会这般诬告我。”

“你为何说他挟怨报复？”

“大人有所不知，先前这赖川在城里调戏姑娘，被我撞见，我喝斥他后，命长随打跑他，从他手上解救下那姑娘，他恐怕是因此对我怀恨于心，所以才如此诬告我。”他一脸忿忿不平再道：“再说我与舍妹自来感情深厚，我有何理由要买通外人来杀她，还望大人明察，别让草民因为如此小人的诬告，而蒙受不白之冤。”

“你说的也不无道理，杀人总该有动机，此事本府会再仔细调查个清，娄二少爷且先回去吧。”

因娄家有皇商的身分，平素里对他的孝敬没少爷，故而严大人对类梓纲也有几分维护之意，三言两语就放了人。

娄德山气急败坏的怒喝，“知府大人今日为何派人节来拘你，你又犯了什么事？”先前因儿子跑去与人贩卖私盐，下过一次牢，当时他费了不少力气，才将儿子从牢里捞出来。不久前得知儿子又被两名官差带去衙门，把他气得当场摔了一只端砚。

因此儿子一回来，他随即将人叫来书房里，责问此事。

“爹，这回是有人诬告我。”心知赖川的事他纵使不说，爹也会从陪他同去的随从那里问出来，这事瞒不住父亲，他只好紧咬住诬告两个字，撇清此事。“我问你，这是怎么回事？”

娄梓纲将他与严大人所说的话，择要告诉父亲。

“您说这岂有此理，那地痞竟指我买凶让他去杀害竹心，这不是诬告是什么？我有什么理由要这么做，好端端的，我做什么要害死自个儿的妹妹，我疯了不成？”他露出气愤难平的表情。

娄德山狐疑道：“那地痞怎么会这么诬指你？”

“我瞧他这是存心报复我。”他再将自己撞见那赖川调戏姑娘的事，搬出来应付父亲。

“既然是此人诬告你，这事想来严大人会查清楚，你往后行事谨慎点，少招惹这种人。”告诫儿子一顿，娄德山便挥手让儿子离去。

娄梓纲被传进公堂的事，不久便传得整个娄府都听闻了。

娄梓维一得知此事，便急匆匆去找娄梓修。

“大哥，你听说二哥的事没？”

“听说了。”娄梓修摆手遣退房里的下人。

“大哥先前曾说，四妹的死有些蹊跷，难不成她真的是被人害死？”娄梓维以前与这这四妹并不怎么亲近，但自她遇上船难之后，忽然变得聪慧起来，出了几个不错的主意，他如今已有几分欣赏这个妹妹，前阵子她骤逝，一度令他有些惋惜。

“四妹的遗体运回来时，我曾暗中嘱咐一个替她换寿衣的丫头查看过她的身子，她身上并无其它的伤痕，应是溺死无疑。”

“那你先前为何说她死得蹊跷？”他以为是大哥发现了什么。

娄梓修不疾不徐解释，“这溺死也有分是自个儿不慎失足溺死，抑或是被人推下水溺水。”

娄梓维神色一动，“你的意思是说，四妹有可能不是自己失足溺死，而是被人推下水才溺死？”

“是否如此，我也不知。”嘴上虽这么说，娄梓修心里却已笃定，四妹定是被二弟给买凶害死，至于原因，八成是因为那件事。

看来那天四妹确实看见了不该看见的事，娄梓纲以为自个儿和伍姨娘的事神不知鬼不觉，除了他们两人，就只有四妹知晓，所以便杀她灭口。

殊不知，他早已察觉两人私通，之所以没有揭发他们，不过是想在最合适的时候再来揭露此事，让娄梓纲彻底翻不了身。

如今机会已送到他手上，不过为免父亲认为他不顾手足之情，落井下石，不能由他来捅破这个秘密。

他觑了眼娄梓维，下一瞬便暗自摇头，三弟性子急躁，只怕成事不足败事有余。

娄梓维越发怀疑妹妹之死另有隐情，“四妹好端端的怎会独自一人跑去池子边赏月，偏还这么巧就溺死了，八成是庄子里和她身边那些奴才撒了谎，我这就让人把以前伺候她的那个奴婢抓来盘问。”

娄梓修怕他打草惊蛇，连忙阻止他，“她身边那几个侍女在四妹出事后，由母亲亲自问过，你跑去问她们，置母亲于何地。”

“难道四妹的死咱们就不管了吗？

巡事只是咱们的臆测，并无证据。》

“可是……”终归是自个儿的妹妹，明知她有可能是遭人所害，他无法坐视不理。

娄梓修温言劝慰他，“你听大哥的话，咱们再暗中找找，看能不能找到什么线索再说。”他不能让三弟在这时候坏了他的好事，引起娄梓纲母子的戒心。

四妹溺死在庄子里，他都看得出来其中的疑点，秦氏又岂会看不出来，却没再追查下去，轻易就接受庄子里传来的说词，这其中难保不是秦氏刻意帮着她儿子掩饰。

翌日，得知严大人审完娄梓纲之后竟当场放走他，寒招财有些难以置信。

“赖川分明指认了他，严大人为何不把他抓进里，还放了他？”

“娄梓纲反指赖川是挟怨报复诬告他，因他没有犯案的理由，所以严大人才会放了他。当然，这其中不免也是严大人看在娄家皇商的身分上才放人。”路挽风解释。
content_en:
"Who is that person?" Han Zhaocai couldn't wait to know the answer.

"Laichuan confessed that the person was Lou Zigang." As the only legitimate son of the Lou family, Lou Zigang couldn't figure out why he wanted to bribe an outsider to kill his sister.

"It's him? Why did he do this?" Han Zhaocai was a little surprised when he heard that it was him.

"Lai Chuan doesn't know the reason. How did Lou Zigang treat you in the Lou family before?" Lu Wanfeng tried to find out the reason why Lou Zigang found someone to kill her.

"Although we weren't very close, he didn't give me any hard time during the few months I was at Lou's house." Han Zhaocai thought, "Do you remember the last time I discussed it with you and saw the two incomplete memories of Lou Zhuxin? Could it be that Lou Zhuxin found out something about him, so he kept looking for someone to get rid of her?"

"It seems so, otherwise he has no reason to do this." I don't know what the reason was, but Lou Zigang ignored the love between brother and sister and cruelly let someone kill her.

"Since Na Laichuan has confessed Lou Zigang, will the prefect arrest him and punish him?" Han Zhaocai asked with concern.

"Captain Yang has gone to report this matter to Master Yan. Master Yan should order someone to arrest Lou Zigang."

"Is that going to be a death sentence?" This man is so hateful and has no regard for brotherhood. He deserves the punishment he deserves.

Lu Wanfeng shook his head, "Not yet. Logically, I will interrogate him first."

At this time, in the courtroom, after receiving the report from Capt. Yang, Lord Yan, the prefect, issued an order to interrogate Lou Zigang.

Being brought into the court, Lou Zigang questioned with some dissatisfaction, "Sir Yan, you ordered people to summon the common people to come. I don't know why?"

"Someone has reported that you were involved in a murder case."

"Who is making such random slander? How could I, the dignified young master of the Lou family, be involved in any murder case? Don't listen to others' false accusations." Lou Zigang scolded angrily.

Master Yan took a picture of the gavel and warned him, "Don't roar in court. This government handles the case and will find out clearly and deal with it impartially."

Lou Zigang immediately calmed down his anger and said, "My lord, please forgive me. The common people just now felt righteous and indignant because they were falsely accused."

"Someone accused you of buying a murder girl, giving the killer a thousand taels of silver, and asking him to kill Miss Lou Si for you. Is this true?"

"There is absolutely no such thing. This person is clearly talking nonsense! No one in this city knows that my sister-in-law died of water when she went to Zhuangzi to escape the summer heat. What does it have to do with me?" Lou Zigang then asked angrily, "May I ask, sir, who is this person who falsely accused me?"

"The name of the person who testified against you is Lai Chuan. Do you know him?"

Lou Zigang was horrified, but he said calmly, "It turns out it's him. He's a gangster in Suyun City. He was clearly seeking revenge, so he falsely accused me like this."

"Why do you say he is seeking revenge?"

"My lord, I don't know. I caught Lai Chuan teasing a girl in the city earlier. After I scolded him, I beat him away and rescued the girl from his hands. I'm afraid he had a grudge against me, so he made such a false accusation."I."He continued with an indignant look on his face: "Besides, I have a deep relationship with my roommate. Why would I want to bribe an outsider to kill her? I hope you will understand and don't let the common people suffer unjust injustice because of such a villain's false accusation."

"What you said is not unreasonable. There must be a motive for killing. This government will investigate this matter carefully. Second Young Master Lou should go back first."

Since the Lou family was an imperial merchant, they usually showed less filial respect to him than a young master, so Mr. Yan was somewhat protective of Lei Zigang and let him go after just a few words.

Lou Deshan shouted angrily, "Why did the magistrate send someone to arrest you today? What did you do?" He had been imprisoned once because his son ran away to sell illegal salt with others. At that time, he spent a lot of effort to get his son out of prison.Not long ago, he learned that his son was taken to the Yamen by two officials. He was so angry that he threw an inkstone on the spot.

Therefore, as soon as his son came back, he immediately called someone to the study to question him about the matter.

"Father, someone is falsely accusing me this time." He knew that even if he didn't say anything about Lai Chuan, his father would ask him about it from the entourage who accompanied him. He couldn't hide the matter from his father, so he had no choice but to stick to the word "false accusation" and stay clear of the matter."Let me ask you, what's going on?"

Lou Zigang decided to tell his father what he had said to Master Yan.

"You think this is unreasonable. The gangster accused me of hiring a murderer to kill Zhu Xin. Isn't this a false accusation? What reason do I have for doing this? What am I doing to kill my own sister? Am I crazy?" He showed an expression of indignation.

Lou Deshan asked suspiciously: "How could that ruffian accuse you so falsely?"

"I think he is deliberately retaliating against me." He then brought it out that he had caught Laichuan teasing the girl and dealt with his father.

"Since this person is falsely accusing you, I think Master Yan will find out about this matter. You should be more careful in the future and avoid provoking such people." After warning his son, Lou Deshan waved his son away.

The news that Lou Zigang was brought to court soon spread to the entire Lou family.

As soon as Lou Ziwei learned about this, he hurried to find Lou Zixiu.

"Brother, have you heard about the second brother?"

"I heard." Lou Zixiu waved his servants away from the room.

"Brother said before that the death of the fourth sister was a bit strange. Could it be that she was really killed by someone?" Lou Ziwei was not very close to the fourth sister before, but after she met the shipwreck, she suddenly became smarter and came up with some good ideas. He now appreciates this sister somewhat. Her sudden death not long ago made him a little regretful.

"When the fourth sister's body was brought back, I secretly asked the girl who changed her shroud to check her body. There were no other injuries on her body. She must have drowned."

"Then why did you say her death was strange?" He thought his elder brother had discovered something.

Lou Zixiu explained without hesitation, "This drowning may be due to him accidentally slipping and drowning, or being pushed into the water and drowning."

Lou Ziwei's expression changed, "You mean to say that the fourth sister might not have lost her footing and drowned herself, but was pushed into the water and drowned?"

"Whether that's the case, I don't know." Although he said this, Lou Zixiu was already convinced in his heart that the fourth sister must have been murdered by his second brother. As for the reason, it was probably because of that incident.

It seems that the fourth sister did see something she shouldn't have seen that day. Lou Zigang thought that the matter between himself and Aunt Wu was unknown to anyone. Apart from the two of them, only the fourth sister knew about it, so he killed her to silence her.

Little did he know that he had already noticed that the two were having an affair, and the reason why he did not expose them was just to expose the matter at the most appropriate time, so that Lou Zigang would be completely unable to turn over.

Now the opportunity has been given to him, but in order to prevent his father from thinking that he is disregarding brotherhood and adding insult to injury, he cannot reveal this secret.

He glanced at Lou Ziwei, and shook his head secretly for a moment. The third disciple was impatient, and he was afraid that if he failed to succeed, he would fail.

Lou Ziwei became more and more suspicious of his sister's death. "How could the fourth sister, who was so good, run to the pool to admire the moon alone, and drown to death by such a coincidence? Zhuangzili and the slaves around her probably lied. I will have the slave who served her before be arrested for questioning."

Lou Zixiu was afraid that he might alert the enemy, so he quickly stopped him, "My mother personally asked those maids around her after the Fourth Sister's accident. Go and ask them where they left your mother."

"Are we not going to care about Fourth Sister's death?

The patrol is just our conjecture and there is no evidence.》

"But..." After all, it was his sister, and knowing that she might be harmed by others, he couldn't just sit back and watch.

Lou Zixiu comforted him with gentle words, "Listen to brother, let's search secretly to see if we can find any clues."He can't let his third brother spoil his good deeds at this time and arouse the wariness of Lou Zigang's mother and son.

The fourth sister drowned in Zhuangzi, and he could see the doubts in it. How could Mrs. Qin not see it, but she did not pursue it further, and easily accepted the explanation from Zhuangzi. There was no guarantee that Mrs. Qin was not deliberately helping her son cover up.

The next day, Han Zhaocai was a little unbelievable when he learned that Mr. Yan actually let Lou Zigang go on the spot after interrogating him.

"Laichuan clearly identified him, why didn't Mr. Yan arrest him and let him go?"

"Lou Zigang countered that Lai Chuan falsely accused him out of revenge. Because he had no reason to commit the crime, Master Yan let him go.Of course, it is unavoidable that Master Yan released him because of his status as an imperial merchant of the Lou family."Lu Wanfeng explained.
